fields.name: View
fields.evidence: ecl::splitscreen::ViewSystem::Update (EoCClient.dll+0x834200): view = 3 unless AnimationSingleton bit 0x2 is set; then 0 when not force-merged and both players have characters (split), 1 when one is missing, or MergedFocus.FocusPlayer + 1 (1 = player 1 fullscreen, 2 = player 2) when MergedFocus is set. On change: comp[1] = comp[0]; comp[0] = view. Read by 13 systems (macOS: camera::TargetSystem, sound::RoomSystem, crowds::SoundVolumeSystem, ...). Default 0x0101 (macOS mov w0,#0x101; strh), live 01 01.

fields.name: PreviousView
fields.evidence: Same function copies the old byte 0 into byte 1 before storing the new view. Live 1.

open_questions: Exact meaning of view value 3 (animation not running / no viewport); names are ours.
